extension.summary: Rebuild the current container on demand
extension.description: A one-line script with no UI. Kodi's JSON-RPC has no way to run a builtin, so scripts that change what a plugin directory would return (pausing a game, which swaps its Games-row tile for a freeze-frame) have no way to make the home screen notice. This addon exists purely so Addons.ExecuteAddon can reach Container.Refresh from outside Kodi. Run by ~/couch/tools/kodi-refresh-games, which only calls it while the home screen is showing.
